summary: Implemented Lambda (array.py) and Lambdad with LambdaD/LambdaDict aliases (dictionary.py), added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst, and added tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Nothing was run (no tests, flake8, or black), and nothing was committed. Lambda asserts callability; Lambdad builds one internal Lambda and applies it to each listed key on a shallow dict copy. The only edited existing line is the typing import in dictionary.py, which now reads "from typing import Callable, Optional".
